entities.text:
Munsif Cum Judicial Magistrate,
First Class, Hazaribagh
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for petitioners submits that there are general and omnibus allegations against the petitioners of assault and before filing of the present case, the sister of the petitioners has lodged the case under section 498A IPC being Barkatha PS Case No.48 of 2022 and Barkatha PS Case No.135 of 2022, and three days thereafter present case has been lodged against the petitioners and petitioners have got no criminal antecedent as disclosed in para 27.
4. Learned State counsel opposes prayer and submits that allegation are there of assault.
5.

Considering that the petitioners have got no criminal antecedent as disclosed above, and the present case has been filed after filing of aforesaid two cases, I am inclined to grant anticipatory bail to petitioners.

6. Accordingly, petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before learned court within three weeks from today, and in event of their surrender/arrest, petitioners, above named, shall be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of like amount each, to satisfaction of learned Munsif Cum Judicial Magistrate, First Class,
Hazaribagh, in connection with Barkatha PS Case No.136 of 2022, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 482(2) of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS), 2023.

( Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi, J.) SI/
